doubts: A network page of several tracks; W1 is the full Lauder Station Road to Cluden Creek car park crossing given in the first heading (made of W2, W3 and W4), listed as main. No road-end features exist, so road and car park ends are null. Shapes of the individual tracks are taken as one-way from their 'from ... to ...' descriptions; the page does not say whether they are walked return. The gate from Cluden Creek car park onto Cluden Creek Track is locked. Lauder Basin Hut is mentioned only for the 4WD sidle down to it; whether the main 4WD road passes it is unclear. Chain Hills Track is linked to the Lindis Valley tracks page (L1); T1 is the map track of the same name.
